findings.description: Setting EXPORT_BATCH_SIZE to 50 exceeds cedar's max_rows_per_request of 40. Every batch request to cedar would be rejected in full, halting exports at that site.
findings.reasoning: Review identifies that batch size 50 exceeds cedar's limit of 40, quotes the rejection policy, and explains that all 70 ready rows would be stuck.

findings.description: The elm site (max 100) would handle batch size 50 without issue.
findings.reasoning: Review notes the asymmetric impact: elm at limit 100 handles it fine, cedar at 40 does not.
